safety_notice: These are generic invented test rules, not official institutional policies. Replace only with approved policy documents before production.

rules.title: Human approval required
rules.rule: Do not submit or publish any grant package without explicit PI/Research Office approval.

rules.title: Provenance required
rules.rule: Each funding-call assertion must link to an official source URL, locator and supporting excerpt.

rules.title: Budget ceiling
rules.rule: The itemized budget must not exceed the verified call ceiling; every cost category needs a source-backed rule.

rules.title: Data protection
rules.rule: Keep draft proposals and personal data accessible only to authorized reviewers.

rules.title: Human-subject research
rules.rule: If a proposed project uses human participant or clinical data, record ethics-review requirements and keep approval status pending until evidence is provided.
